scope: Targeted primary-source decision review, not an exhaustive systematic review or numerical reproduction

sources.title: Stimulus identity rather than emotion drives EEG classification on the FACED dataset
sources.access: Indexed primary abstract reviewed; direct full-text request returns HTTP 403
sources.verified_scope: LinearSVC/CLISA, stimulus-assigned versus individual reports, stimulus diversity and temporal-split confounding
sources.limitation: Exact full methods, individual-label construction and all split details remain unaudited
sources.decision_inference: A general FACED stimulus-confounding or individual-versus-assigned-label paper has substantial overlap

sources.title: Low-Cost Video-Time Priors as a Strong Baseline for EEG-fNIRS Emotion Regression on Familiar Videos
sources.status: arXiv preprint v1, 2 October 2026; independent conference acceptance not checked
sources.access: Full primary HTML reviewed, especially sections 3.1, 6.3-6.4 and conclusion
sources.verified_scope: Familiar time-aligned videos, source video-time prior and physiological residual correction; explicitly excludes unseen-video evaluation
sources.decision_inference: An incremental-EEG/context comparison alone overlaps; crossed participant/video evaluation is also explicitly proposed as future work

sources.title: Modeling Shared and Individual Structure for Cross-Subject Continuous Affect Regression from EEG-fNIRS
sources.status: arXiv v1 submitted 2 October 2026 at 04:37:59 UTC; manuscript citation line says 5 October
sources.access: Five-page primary PDF read; rendered pages 3-4 inspected; HTML route returns HTTP 404
sources.verified_scope: 24 training/8 held participants, same 15 videos, population trajectories plus label-free synchrony calibration; section 5.4 negative search focuses on arousal
sources.limitation: No local reproduction, unseen-film evaluation or accepted-paper status established
sources.decision_inference: Shared-versus-individual affect and a broad failed-model search cannot be claimed as new; valence and unseen-film conclusions require separate evidence

sources.title: Multi-dataset Joint Pre-training of Emotional EEG Enables Generalizable Affective Computing
sources.access: Official record and primary full HTML checked, including limitations and imagery appendix
sources.verified_scope: Joint emotional-EEG pretraining and cross-dataset/imagery transfer; acknowledges unmodeled individual emotional experience
sources.decision_inference: Pooling, adding a transformer, or imagery transfer alone is insufficient novelty

sources.title: In Search of Lost Generalization: An Honest Benchmark for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
sources.status: Author repository says under review at IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing, 2026
sources.access: Current author README reviewed; numerical pipeline and complete manuscript not reproduced
sources.verified_scope: Source-validation versus held-subject oracle checkpoint selection and richer-input controls on SEED/SEED-IV
sources.decision_inference: Honest checkpoint selection and failed richer-representation searches alone overlap existing work

sources.title: LibEER: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Algorithm Library for EEG-based Emotion Recognition
sources.access: Primary full HTML, tasks and conclusion checked
sources.verified_scope: Standardized preprocessing, trial splits, model benchmarking and reproducibility; cross-subject terminology defined explicitly
sources.decision_inference: Releasing a smaller generic evaluation library is not a sufficient stand-alone contribution

sources.title: Evaluation in EEG Emotion Recognition: State-of-the-Art Review and Unified Framework
sources.status: arXiv v1, 14 May 2025; record says submitted to IEEE for possible publication
sources.access: Primary abstract and submission history reviewed
sources.verified_scope: Review of 216 papers, standardized evaluation across six corpora and four established architectures
sources.decision_inference: Ground-truth/split/metric harmonization already has explicit framework precedents

sources.title: A Large Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset
sources.access: Primary published methods plus earlier local codebook/raw qualification
sources.verified_scope: 123 people, 28 video clips, retrospective 12-item individual reports on a continuous 0-7 scale
sources.decision_inference: Supports individual retrospective valence; does not supply moment-to-moment affect ground truth

sources.title: A Multi-Context Emotional EEG Dataset for Cross-Context Emotion Decoding
sources.verified_scope: Video/imagery induction, individual reports; some video collection provenance is FACED; first-party cross-context classification already exists
sources.decision_inference: Candidate external cohort only after execution/rating joins, endpoints and physical material overlap are resolved

sources.title: ACII 2025 official programme
sources.access: Official programme checked; call-for-papers route inaccessible
sources.verified_scope: Includes affective datasets, evaluation, valence prediction and physiological sensing
sources.decision_inference: A natural specialist venue family to consider for a substantive evaluation/affective finding; no future deadline or acceptance prediction

sources.title: ICASSP 2027 official call for papers
sources.verified_scope: Biomedical signal processing and machine learning; displayed regular-paper deadline 23 September 2026
sources.decision_inference: Consider a later cycle if a focused signal-processing contribution emerges; the displayed regular 2027 deadline has passed
